name: Bella
source:
Bella is [url=https://vndb.org/c131855]Frank[/url]'s biological older sister. She had always wished to have a younger sibling and even had names picked out for whether it was a boy or a girl. Her dream finally came true when she was 7 years old and her parents decided to use the name she had come up with. She helped her parents take care of Frank as much as she could but that only lasted 6 months. As Frank grew up, his presence was becoming harder and harder to hide, which was drawing unwanted attention to their home. Their parents had to make the heartbreaking decision to send Bella away to live in Old Oathwell with [url=https://vndb.org/c131900]Draxus[/url].

Living with Draxus was great at first. She was heartbroken that she couldn't live with her family, but Draxus did a great job of distracting her and finding ways to make her happy.

When Bella was 11, the First Ones attacked Oathwell in an effort to crush the Oathbound on the same night that [url=https://vndb.org/c131867]Harpocrates[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c132329]Thoth[/url] were sent to kidnap Frank. Despite putting up a fierce resistance, the Oathbound suffered many losses and Draxus was forced to retreat and escape with Bella or he risked her being killed in the crossfire.

They lived on the run for many years, during this time, Draxus taught Bella how to fight and use the magical abilities she had inherited from her [url=https://vndb.org/c170813]father[/url]. When Bella was 19, Draxus had finally managed to find most of the Oathbound who were still alive and they rebuilt the organization along with some new recruits. Bella finally stopped living on the run and began to search for any sign of Frank.

When Frank moved to Walton and met [url=https://vndb.org/c131865]Tamia[/url], Bella was so happy to hear the news that she had to be physically held down to prevent her from running off to go see him again. Bella was reluctant to stay idle, but ultimately she listened to reason and remained in Oathwell to avoid giving away their position while their scouts were investigating him and the gods. An attack from Harpocrates now would be the end of the Oathbound. Only their scouts could blend in and mask their actions as those of the Order to avoid that fate.

In the chaos of [url=https://vndb.org/c131888]Dagon[/url]'s summoning ritual at the festival, they were finally able to retrieve Frank. Bella finally got her long awaited reunion.

[In game description]
